descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
本接口用于查看所有模型服务信息。
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制默认为1000次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

This interface is used to view all model service information.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. Exceeding the limit will trigger API rate limiting, which may impact your business. Please call the API responsibly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb list-model-services --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
